people.name: Antioch
people.line: A major city where the gospel spread to Gentiles.

translations.web: From there they sailed to Antioch, from where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work which they had fulfilled.
translations.bsb: From Attalia they sailed to Antioch, where they had been commended to the grace of God for the work they had just completed.
translations.kjv: And thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled.
